advisory.finding: The EV-3c ignored-alias tests assert only that the removed legacy env is not honored (value equals default/canonical) but do not assert that setting the removed alias emits NO deprecation/alias warning — unlike the EV-1/EV-3a analogues (test_config_sync_aliases.test_no_sync_does_not_emit_alias_warning, test_config_ev3a_aliases.test_compact_legacy_alias_ignored_without_alias_warning) which do. scenarios: A regression that re-introduces a deprecation warning (or a raw warning bypassing the registry) for these retired env names would not be caught by the EV-3c tests.
